test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MAZZA' is written as 'OBBAC' and 'BLACK' is written as ‘DMCDM’. How will 'FUZZY' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13df3c7bae8c7228feed7c818dc622984b106762d738750acdf022ec2e4eda09.png] 

Here,

'MAZZA' is written as 'OBBAC' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfe8cb1f2e86d7f7955210a7f5d0d6a17a047195b53edf9027390176928c93cb.png] 

'BLACK' is written as ‘DMCDM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b70ae13d016e152bcc00643ab6c965b836948217afaacc96003ffed25f54f910.png] 

Similarly, for 'FUZZY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcc27973bbf9e903906572af96c722337e816ea7e83c5c83772ff45c4a2c8a73.png] 

So, 'FUZZY' will be written as ‘HVBAA ’

Hence, '**HVBAA**' is the correct answer.
